items.title: «Velsigne dette land»
items.teaser: An earthbound, gently spiritual choral piece from the opera Marko og Adriane, well suited as an accessible concert work.
items.body:
«Velsigne dette land» (Bless This Land) is an intimate choral setting for SATB choir and piano, originating from the opera "Marko og Adriane".

Characterized by melodic warmth, flowing voice leading, and an unpretentious, contemplative spirit, the piece offers a serene blessing over nature, life, and community. With its accessible vocal range and gentle tempo, it works equally well as an evocative concert piece or an anthem of peace.

items.title: «Victory's Desolation» Published for Concert Band
items.teaser: Movement III from Suite for Concert Band is now available with full score, parts, and score video.
items.body:
The piece portrays Marko on the battlefield after striking down his beloved Adriane—sorrowful, violent, mad, yet sustained by hope.

Premiered by Ulefoss Musikkorps at the 2025 Anniversary Revue. Arranged for Grade 3.5 with flexible instrumentation and extensive cross-cueing.

items.title: «Market in Lydia» Available for Concert Band
items.teaser: Movement II from Suite for Concert Band. A lively and spirited concert march in Grade 2.5.
items.body: Movement II from Suite for Concert Band captures the vivid atmosphere and rhythmic energy of the market scenes. Designed to be both pedagogical and musically engaging for ensembles at Grade 2.5.

items.title: Symphony No. 1 Score Revision Completed
items.teaser: Full score revision of the four-movement symphony prepared for orchestral presentation and reading sessions.
items.body: The extensive revision of Symphony No. 1 has now been finalized. The full score and instrumental parts have been carefully revised and formatted for large symphony orchestra, bringing the work into its final third edition.

items.title: New Composer Website and Works Catalogue Launched
items.teaser: A dedicated home for orchestral works, concert band compositions, choral pieces, and upcoming news.
items.body: Welcome to the new official website. Here you will find an up-to-date works catalogue with instrumentation details, audio samples, score video excerpts, and direct links to available sheet music editions.
